title: Molecular allergy testing
what: This blood test shows which exact allergen proteins your body reacts to. Many allergens are checked at once.
why: When standard tests do not give a clear answer, for allergies to many foods or pollens, before allergy shots, and after severe reactions.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; results usually come in a few days, up to 2 weeks
tell_doctor: What you react to and how. Write it down ahead of time
If you had severe reactions, swelling, or fainting
If you are getting allergen treatment or allergy shots

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: It is usually best to come in the morning, 3 to 4 hours after a light meal or on an empty stomach. Check with the lab.

prepare.title: Allergy pills
prepare.text: They usually do not affect a blood test. Do not stop them on your own. Ask your doctor.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: A sleeve you can easily roll up above the elbow.

bring: Your referral or list of tests
A list of your reactions: to what, when, and how bad
steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tied above your elbow, and you are asked to clench your fist a few times
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
A quick prick. Blood fills the tubes in a few seconds
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse, and they will help you lie down
Tell your child there will be just one prick, with no skin tests
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes
An allergist will explain the result. On its own, it is not a diagnosis
Do not cut foods from your diet without your doctor's advice
red_flags: The puncture site is very swollen, painful, and red

faq.q: Can I do the test during a flare-up?
faq.a: Yes. You can do this blood test while taking allergy pills and during a flare-up.

faq.q: How is this better than a standard test?
faq.a: It shows exactly which protein you react to. This helps judge the risk of severe reactions and choose treatment.

reminders.text: Allergy blood test tomorrow. Write down what you react to. Take your allergy pills as usual.
